bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 7 月下旬低点

read.en: ASML fell 2.5% on Nov 2 to $1,526.14, trading between $1,518.00 and $1,600.80. It is below the rising 5-day ($1,613.2) and 200-day ($1,598.2) and the falling 10-day ($1,609.7), 30-day ($1,708.7) and 100-day ($1,740.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,690.10), and RSI is 36.

The rebound stalled under the 200-day at $1,600.8 and the close broke the $1,530.6–1,550 support (Jul 29, Oct 30 and Oct 23 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $1,530.6–1,550, then $1,598.2–1,613.2 (200, 10 and 5-day, Nov 2 high) and $1,690 (SAR). Support is $1,493.5 (Jan 28 high), then $1,475–1,480 and $1,441.3 (May 19 low). A close above $1,550 would target $1,598–1,613; below $1,493, $1,475–1,480.
